He has been officially nominated under Indian Panorma for Best Debutant Director for his film Binodini Ekti Natir Upakhyan at [[IFFI]] 2025.{{Cite news |date=2025-11-12 |title=The IFFI nod proves hard work and honesty still matter, says Ram Kamal Mukherjee |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/bengali/movies/news/the-iffi-nod-proves-hard-work-and-honesty-still-matter-says-ram-kamal-mukherjee/articleshow/125249716.cms |access-date=2025-11-21 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} ==Personal information== Mukherjee completed his graduation in History from the [[University of Calcutta]]. He completed his schooling from [[St Joseph's College]] in Calcutta, and later completed his senior schooling from Khalsa Model School. After graduation he completed a diploma course in communication from the British Council, later joined Media Studies Film and Television course in University of Calcutta.{{cite news |date=22 March 2005 |title= The programme was conducted by author Ram Kamal Mukherjee, a noted film journalist and alumnus of the host department |url=http://www.telegraphindia.com/1050322/asp/calcutta/story_4520589.asp |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060427051318/http://www.telegraphindia.com/1050322/asp/calcutta/story_4520589.asp |url-status=dead |archive-date=27 April 2006 |work=Telegraph India}} ==Career== Mukherjee is best known as a biographer of Hema Malini's authorized biography Beyond The Dreamgirl and India's first Power Brand Film Journalist. After working with Times of India (Mumbai Mirror) as assistant editor, he worked with Pritish Nandy Communication as vice president and wrote columns in Midday and Ananda Bazar Patrika. Later he worked as Associate Producer in Zee TV finite series Bin Kuch Kahe. He is best known for writing India's first [[coffee table book]] on any actress, ''[[Hema Malini - Diva Unveiled]]'', which was published by Magna Books in 2005.{{cite news |date=19 January 2005 |title= Hema Malini - Diva Unveiled |url=http://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/1192071/Hema-Malini---Diva-Unveiled |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150910172148/http://www.bollywoodhungama.com/news/1192071/Hema-Malini---Diva-Unveiled |url-status=dead |archive-date=10 September 2015 |work=Bollywood Hungama}} He was the assistant producer of the TV series [[Bin Kuch Kahe]] aired on [[Zee TV]]. In 2019 he made his debut as filmmaker with Cakewalk starring [[Esha Deol]] in the lead role. In 2020 his film Season's Greetings, a tribute to [[Rituparno Ghosh]] fetched him national and international accolades. The film also marked return of former Miss India [[Celina Jaitly]] Haag into cinema. In 2021 he won the Best Human Rights Film at Cardiff International Film Festival for his film Rickshawala. As an author he penned six books, in English and Hindi languages. His biography Beyond The Dreamgirl published by HarperCollins India, was released by [[Deepika Padukone]] in Mumbai.{{Cite web|title=Deepika Padukone Launches Hema Malini's Biography Beyond The Dream Girl. Pics Here|url=https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/deepika-padukone-launches-hema-malinis-biography-beyond-the-dream-girl-pics-here-1763839|access-date=14 April 2021|website=NDTV.com|date=11 October 2017 }} The foreword of the book was written by Prime Minister of India Mr [[Narendra Modi]]. extract: Ram Kamal Mukherjee (born 13 September 1976) is an Indian film journalist, the former editor in chief of Stardust film magazine, biographer of Hema Malini, Mithun Chakraborty and Sanjay Dutt. He made his debut as filmmaker with Cakewalk starring Esha Deol. He has been regarded as one of the best Indian short filmmaker by The Times of India. In 2023 he won 69th National Film Award for his short film Ek Duaa. He has been officially nominated under Indian Panorma for Best Debutant Director for his film Binodini Ekti Natir Upakhyan at IFFI 2025.
